packageRules.description: @types/node tracks the engines floor (node >=20.15). Newer types would let Node-24-only APIs typecheck clean and then fail at runtime on a supported Node 20 consumer. Raise this together with engines.
typescript-eslint peers typescript <6.1.0 on both latest and canary, so TypeScript 6+ cannot resolve. Lift once typescript-eslint ships support.

The js-yaml override exists to dedupe the dev tree onto one copy. openapi-typescript pins @redocly/openapi-core ^1.34.x, which calls the js-yaml 4 `types.merge` export that js-yaml 5 removed; forcing 5 breaks `npm run openapi:check`. Lift once openapi-typescript moves to redocly 2.x.
